answer: Random peer audit stops bulk forgery. An agent posts a 40 POA bond to claim a slot, then five peers re-check its trades. Honest agents form an oasis: pass and the bond returns after 20 epochs; fail and it burns. Forging 100 identities costs 100 x 40 = 4,000 POA, while each fake earns under 5 POA per epoch, so the attack never pays. Each honest agent pays once, keeps its bond, and its shale-layered record grows harder to fake, like proven marble.
